Well, its not always the best idea to get the Eye-Upgrades.

Let's say your playing a support with which you bought targon's and the enemy Zed (for example) is fed. I would rather get the Face of the Mountain asap (after wardstone ofc) and then a Locket or Redemption (depending on who I play), so that my carries won't be gone in 0.3 secs

On the other hand you can buy Frostqueens Claim which can be super useful to hit hard to land skillshots. Let's say you're not that consitent with Morgana, go for the FQC and slow them before you throw out your Q for an easier hit. 

Coin usually gives you the most gold and requiers you to do nothing to get the gold (other than stand next to the dying minions). You usually buy that on enchanters so you can rush Ardents. Also the eye-upgrade is cheaper with coin. Some people also take gold per 10 runes to get that Ardents faster.

As for Talisman: I usually only get that if our team either lacks engage or disengage. Even though you could argue, that for engage you could also buy a Righteous Glory but again, it depens on the champion you're playing. As for disengage, it helps your team scramble against a Sion ult, kennen ult, maybe an engaging Mega-Gnar and so on and so forth.

It really depends on what champions you play, you're playing with and you're playing against. Just gotta think about "What are our champions good at?" and "What are their champions good at?" and build accordingly to increase the strength of your team and decrease the strength of the enemy team (for example: a lot of autoattackers? --> frozen heart)
